children: Champions Oncology, Inc. reported results for the first quarter ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $15.23M, an 8.8% increase from the year‑ago quarter, and a net loss of $0.43M, essentially flat on a per‑share basis with diluted EPS of $(0.03).
Revenue was $15.232M for Q1 2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up from $13.995M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 8.8%.
Net income was a loss of $(0.426M) for Q1 2027, versus a loss of $(0.466M) in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted earnings per share: Basic net loss per share $(0.03) for Q1 2027, unchanged from $(0.03) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue growth was driven by higher oncology revenue — up 8.8% YoY — led by increased pharmacology services and expansion of TOS data licensing.
Mix shifted toward pharmacology services and data licensing; Lumin SaaS and flow cytometry revenues declined.
Commercial investment increased, with sales & marketing spend up 66.6% to support commercialization and data licensing efforts and to expand the commercial team.
R&D spending rose 12.6%, mainly due to higher share‑based compensation at Corellia as the company advances target discovery capabilities.
Operational efficiency improved: cost of oncology revenue fell 5.8% reflecting lower outsourced lab costs, partially offset by higher royalty expense.
